definitions.gloss: release to the public, opening, disclosure
definitions.explanation: Making something available or accessible to the general public. Used for releasing films, opening facilities, disclosing information, or publishing content.

examples.japanese: {新作|しんさく}が{公開|こうかい}された。
この{情報|じょうほう}は{一般|いっぱん}に{公開|こうかい}されている。
examples.english: This information is open to the public.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}の{公開|こうかい}{日|び}が{来月|らいげつ}に{決|き}まった。
examples.english: The film's release date was set for next month.

notes:
Broadly covers making things accessible to the public — films, buildings, information, documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{一般|いっぱん}{公開|こうかい} (open to the general public)
・{情報|じょうほう}{公開|こうかい} (information disclosure)
・{公開|こうかい}{日|び} (release date)
・{公開|こうかい}{中|ちゅう} (now showing / currently open)
・{非公開|ひこうかい} (private, closed to the public)

DISTINCTIONS:
・{公開|こうかい}: making something accessible to the public (films, facilities, information)
・{発表|はっぴょう}: announcing or presenting (results, plans, research)
・{公表|こうひょう}: officially making information public (formal announcements)
